source: User-reported manual tests in the NobiWriter project conversation
tested_version: pre-1.2.0; exact installed package and model not recorded
note: Reported verdicts are retained. Review findings are not silently substituted for the user's verdict. These ten manual tests are not the R01-R22 suite and do not certify version 1.2.0.

review_findings: Missing rationale, score and usage status
runs.source_excerpt: صعود یا نزول طلا، دو مسیر برای معامله

review_findings: Requested a visual scorecard instead of plain presentation
User identified forbidden tanwin in generated copy; prior review classified this as a failure under the hard writing rule
Correcting pronouns must not turn a user restriction into a platform-wide outage
runs.source_excerpt: در حال حاضر امکان برداشت ریالی ندارید. لطفاً در زمان دیگری دوباره اقدام کنید.

review_findings: Generic, overly cautious promotional copy; creativity and distinctiveness need explicit evaluation
Positive example: registration is not confused with execution; compact evaluation present
A safe uncertainty statement was present, but user wanted a clearer usable alternative rather than an assessment dominated by limitations
Do not infer failed withdrawal, refund timing or recovery routes
runs.source_excerpt: وضعیت نهایی برداشت مشخص نیست. زمان بازگشت احتمالی دارایی نیز مشخص نیست.

review_findings: Only selected criterion scores were shown, so the reported 8.6 and 8.8 totals were not reproducible from the displayed values
Separate base quality from missing surface context instead of withholding all aggregates
The generated analysis also contains tanwin; lint must cover both copy and analysis
runs.source_excerpt: برای مخاطب تازه‌وارد، «طلا کوین» می‌تواند نام یک توکن یا محصول تلقی شود. مخاطب آشنا با رمزارز احتمالاً بازی «کن/کوین» را می‌فهمد.
